description: Recorded between a .NET Framework 4.8 WCF client (DuplexChannelFactory or ChannelFactory with NetTcpBinding, SecurityMode.None) and a .NET Framework 4.8 WCF service hosting the contract slice of sample.py, through a TCP relay on the loopback interface. notes.client_log is what the client printed for each result and callback, notes.service_log what the service printed for each call it received. Scenario: one session calling every operation of the slice once or more, with callbacks raised by Controller_Connect and Worklist_Run and a declared fault from Sampler_Home.

client_log: result: Sampler_Home fault -> "Sender|Sampler is not homed|System.InvalidOperationException: Sampler is not homed <- System.TimeoutException: axis X timed out|http://tempuri.org/IController/Sampler_HomeControllerServiceExceptionFault"
